newsitem.title: USA: Charges dropped in molestation case involving boys.
newsitem.headline: Charges dropped in molestation case involving boys.

text.p: A 14-year-old boy alleged to have molested a 6-year-old in an airport hotel room when they were both stranded during a January snowstorm will not be charged, prosecutors said Tuesday.
A spokeswoman for the Hennepin County prosecutor's office said the evidence was not strong enough to pursue. However, a civil case was under consideration by the family of the 6-year-old.
The unrelated boys, who were travelling without their parents, were placed in the same room of the Airport Hilton in suburban Bloomington by Northwest Airlines, which posted a guard outside the door.
Normally, passengers get separate rooms, but Northwest paired the two boys because there were so many stranded travelers.
